_comment: Pinned list-price table for cost accounting. Prices are USD per 1M tokens at the providers' standard (non-cached, non-batch) tier. This table is a measurement input: its source and pin date are sealed into every run artifact (pricing_source / pricing_date), so a cost figure is always traceable to the table that produced it. Update by bumping 'date' and 'source' together, never silently. 2026-09-27: pinned API model IDs (gpt-5.6-luna, claude-sonnet-5, gemini-3.8-flash, kimi-k3) per each vendor's actual versioning scheme (peira.api_pins); rate entries for these IDs were already in this table and are unchanged, so the API adapters' pinned defaults stay cost-accounted. 2026-09-28: added pricing_version (date + intra-day revision; sealed into run artifacts so a cost figure is traceable to the exact table version) and per-entry confidence ("official" = verified against the vendor pricing page or a first-party $0.0 assertion for self-hosted checkpoints; "secondary" = carried over unverified or gateway-reported). 2026-10-02: Anthropic default pin moved to claude-sonnet-5-5 per D3 latest-only decision (entry marked official); stale default-pin note in claude-opus-5-5 entry corrected. Changelog: 2026-10-03 added 10 OpenRouter gateway rates (OPENROUTER_CHEAP_MODELS pilot set), verified live via openrouter.ai/api/v1/models; version 2026-10-03.1. 2026-10-03 added 5 discounted OpenRouter gateway rates (Mercury 2.5, Qwen3 235B, Ling 3.0 Flash VL, Solar Pro 4, Ling 3.0 Flash), verified live via openrouter.ai/api/v1/models; version 2026-10-03.2. 2026-10-13: added gpt-6.1-sol ($2/$10 per 1M, standard short-context tier), verified against OpenAI's official pricing page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing) on 2026-10-13; version 2026-10-13.1. 2026-10-13: added gpt-6-luna ($0.10/$0.50 per 1M) and gpt-6-astra ($10/$50 per 1M), verified against OpenAI's official pricing page (platform.openai.com/docs/pricing) on 2026-10-13; the gpt-5.6-terra entry ($2/$12 per 1M) already stood at the official rate and was re-verified against its official model page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-terra) on 2026-10-13; version 2026-10-13.2. 2026-10-14: added claude-haiku-5-5 ($0.10/$0.50 per 1M for prompts up to 100,000 tokens; the $0.50/$2.50 tier above 100,000 tokens is not modeled, because trial prompts run a few hundred tokens), verified against Anthropic's official pricing page (docs.claude.com/en/docs/about-claude/pricing) on 2026-10-14; version 2026-10-14.1. 2026-10-14: added jev-1.14.0 ($0.042/$0 per 1M, output free), verified against TypeSafe's official models page (docs.typesafe.ai/models) on 2026-10-14; version 2026-10-14.2. 2026-10-15: added the three Cloudflare Clef decision models on Workers AI (@cf/cloudflare/clef-flash $0.038/$0 per 1M, @cf/cloudflare/clef $0.240/$0 per 1M, @cf/cloudflare/clef-omni $0.150/$0 per 1M; input tokens only, output free), verified against Cloudflare's official Workers AI pricing page and per-model pages (developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing) on 2026-10-15; the clef-flash rate is the 2026-10-09 price cut from $0.090, which also cut its hosted context to 24,576 tokens; version 2026-10-15.1. 2026-10-15: added fastino/GLiNER2.5-Decide ($0.0 per 1M; self-hosted checkpoint whose local inference cost is explicitly unaccounted, never silently estimated, the Laya and Kev convention for self-hosted checkpoints); version 2026-10-15.2. 2026-10-15: added the two Perplexity pplx-decider versions on the hosted Decisions API (pplx-decider-v1.1-27b and pplx-decider-v1-27b, both $0.02/$0 per 1M, input tokens only, output free), verified against Perplexity's official Decisions API documentation (docs.perplexity.ai/docs/decisions/quickstart) on 2026-10-15; the live docs rate of $0.02 supersedes the $0.04 figure carried in pre-launch secondary reporting; version 2026-10-15.3. 2026-10-15: added celeris-1-decision ($0.04/$0 per 1M; input tokens only, output free), the vendor-stated price for Celeris's diffusion decision model on its hosted System One wire, with the wire shape and integer usage counters verified against the live API on 2026-10-15; version 2026-10-15.4. 2026-10-16: added Inception Mercury Decide (mercury-decide, $0.02/$0 per 1M, input tokens only, output free), verified against the models list served by Inception's API (api.inceptionlabs.ai/v1/models) on 2026-10-16; version 2026-10-15.5. 2026-10-22: added apertixai/cerno-4b ($0.0 per 1M; self-hosted checkpoint whose local inference cost is explicitly unaccounted, never silently estimated, the Laya and Kev convention for self-hosted checkpoints); version 2026-10-15.6. 2026-10-23: added apertixai/cerno-9b and apertixai/cerno-27b ($0.0 per 1M; same self-hosted convention, the sibling Cerno pins resolved live from the Hub on 2026-10-23); version 2026-10-15.7. 2026-10-23: added the API version-refresh set (grok-4.7, deepseek-v4-pro, glm-5.3, MiniMax-M3.1-flash, gemini-4-argon, pplx-decider-v1.2, pplx-decider-flash-v1.2, inception/mercury-3, inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash, microsoft/microsoft-decision-1), each verified 2026-10-23 against the source named in its entry; version 2026-10-23.1.
basis: USD per 1M tokens, list price, standard tier (no prompt caching, no batch discount, no long-context surcharge)

claude-fable-5-1._note: Frontier-ceiling candidate (2026-09-25, adapter request path landed 2026-09-30). Priced at $10/$50 per 1M, corroborated by multiple Sept-2026 sources (Anthropic pricing page, 9to5Mac 2026-09-01 launch coverage). The model id was confirmed against the live API on 2026-10-14, when owner-run canaries drove this adapter on real v2 trial cases. Those canaries surfaced the temperature deprecation fixed alongside this note, and the full trial run follows that fix. Fable 5.1 rejects forced tool_choice with HTTP 400, so AnthropicAdapter auto-routes this model to native output_config.format structured outputs with no tools and no tool_choice, and numeric schema constraints are stripped per Anthropic's published subset. Responses are parsed through the same typed decision contract as every other model.

Anthropic prices this model by prompt length: prompts over 100,000 tokens pay $0.50/$2.50 per 1M, which this entry does not model, because trial prompts run a few hundred tokens and only the base tier is reachable. The adapter omits temperature for this id (live-verified 400 on 2026-10-14: temperature is deprecated for this model).
